_description: System health snapshot for Rinq. Updated at end of sessions.
_notes: 2026-07-08: Per-queue 'voicemail if no one answers' flag (queues.voicemail_on_no_answer, migration 078, commit b0d4fab, deployed — gunicorn restart 00:15:07 UTC, /health 200, migration applied to watson DB). Desk-phone teams that don't watch the browser dashboard (Chris in Batemans Bay + Wagga) were leaving callers holding an unwatched ringing desk until max_wait_time (~5min) dumped them to VM. Now, when the auto-rung team rings out (no-answer/failed) and no leg remains, queue_agent_ring_status (routes.py ~2415, previously only acted on 'busy' reject) bounces the caller straight to voicemail via _send_queue_caller_to_voicemail (no-ops unless still 'waiting', so answered calls can't be wrongly bounced). Flag off = unchanged hold behaviour, so Canberra/The Hub (12 browser agents, dashboard pickup) is unaffected. Enabled on Batemans Bay (2), Wagga (4), Shoalhaven (5); OFF on Canberra (3) + Test (8). Admin checkbox on queue create/edit forms (wired via _update_row present-keys-only). LIVE RING-OUT TEST NOT YET RUN (the exact gap behind the 2026-07-06 incident) — call Batemans Bay, let it ring out, confirm VM; log line 'rang out and no agents remain (voicemail-on-no-answer)'. Also this session: confirmed watson's queue call flows were ALREADY on plain voicemail for no-answer (not AI receptionist as the 2026-06-29 note implied); the only ai_receptionist value was a DEAD open_no_answer_action on the Extension Directory flow id 5 (never reached — that flow's real fallback is extension_no_answer_action, already voicemail) — normalised flow 5 to voicemail so no ai_receptionist string remains. 2026-07-06: Production incident from Friday's deploy — the Phase 2b sweep (5922337) mangled queue_agent_answer: 'def cancel_others' merged into the comment above it (valid syntax, so nothing failed at deploy), leaving the name undefined. Every auto-ring queue answer 500ed; Twilio played 'an application error has occurred' to the answering agent (Hazel/Chris/Shristi Monday morning); customer stayed stuck in queue. Fixed (cb47da1, newline restored) + deployed (gunicorn restart confirmed 23:27:44 UTC). Only instance of the mangling in that commit (scanned all files). Guardrail added: deploy.yml now has a lint job (pipx run ruff check --select F821 rinq/) that deploy needs — verified it flags Friday's exact bug and that the current codebase is clean (1a1f4cc, pipeline green). Post-deploy runsheet smoke test was NOT run on 2026-07-04, which is why this sat until staff complained. Also: reviewed 2 days of signature-validation LOG-mode logs — all real webhooks validate cleanly; only false negative was GET /api/voice/hold-music (no call params -> tenant=None -> no auth token; enforce would have silenced hold audio). Fixed via SIGNATURE_EXEMPT_PATHS for hold-music + ringback (29dd54f, deployed). Enforce flip: wait 1-2 clean business days, then set enforce in .env + restart. 2026-07-04: Full-codebase quality review (7 parallel review agents, ~170 findings) then fixes in 4 phases, all merged + DEPLOYED to production (7bdfb2f..5922337, deploy green, /health 200 on both domains). ba8f1ef Phase 0 live bugs (7: missing import json in admin_schedule_routes, dropped DND check in monkey-patched fetchQueueCallers, callback Call Back never dialled, undeclared consultTargetAnswered, get_twilio_config() in spawned ring thread killed PSTN forwards, blind transfer cancels ringing target on failed redirect, /setup -> admin_required). a30e1cf Phase 1 security/tenant (X-Twilio-Signature validation in LOG mode via RINQ_TWILIO_SIGNATURE_MODE — flip to enforce after watching logs; middleware membership check on domain adoption; get_current_user denies without tenant_users row; tenant-leak singletons removed; setup-tenant uses full provision_tenant(); phone.html name escaping; per-tenant voicemail_requester_email bot_setting). fd39ab0 Phase 2a (db._update_row() present-keys-only replaced 7 clobber-prone updaters — the June ring_timeout bug class; also live: queue saves reset welcome_audio_id/callback_reminder_audio_id/position_announcement/announcement_interval, Peter sync reset hide_mobile; twilio_list(raise_on_error=True) at transfer decision points). 5922337 Phase 2b/3 (capture_for_thread() NEVER worked — threading.local doesn't cross threads; every bg thread silently used master account, masked because watson IS master; new start_twilio_thread() re-binds tenant in-thread, 13 spawn sites converted, fallback logs warning; ~60 silent exception handlers now log via web/util.py flash_error(); _is_queue_paused datetime fix; identity encode/decode dedup). Watch items: flip signature mode to enforce; restore queue audio + hide_mobile values already lost to past clobbers; watch for master-credential fallback warnings; smoke-test transfers + queue ring. Deliberately unchanged: 'tina' ticket tags/permission keys, tenant-DB FK enforcement, call_state.py transient-error misclassification (TODO'd). Phase 4 deferred: routes.py/db.py/phone.html decomposition, CallSession state machine, async voicemail pipeline, etc.
